title: Gridalyn: a governed SDK for distribution-network digital twins and flexibility studies
description: Gridalyn models, simulates and optimizes multi-scale electric distribution systems and their distributed energy resources: flexible building loads, EV chargers and storage. Declarative YAML StudyProject and Workflow contracts drive synthetic data generation, a digital twin, pandapower/lightsim power flow and flexibility-market operations, emitting governed report artifacts with regression baselines so that a published result can be re-derived from its configuration.
